notes.title: Update 1.1.4b - HAVE FUN!!!
notes.notes: New animations added, after death the restart performance increased, Story failure fixed! HAVE FUN!!!!

notes.title: HUD and Performance Issues fixed
notes.notes:
Bug fiex log: Most performance issues fixed, HUD problems fixed,

Please be patient, the mouse sensitivity still needs to be adjusted separately in the level and the restart function sometimes doesn't respond, but the performance has improved significantly at night.

notes.title: Mouse Sensitivity bug fixed
notes.notes: On some PCs the "mouse sensitivity" didn´t work, so I fixed it.

notes.title: ENOSIS v002b update notes
notes.notes:
The following has been changed or added:

New inventory system

New trading system

More weapons

Some enemies have been improved

Some enemies simply didn't spawn, so this has been fixed

Samaritan NPC not spawning has been added permanently (if the player dies and they are nearby, they heal them)

Crystal Grove scroll fixed

Dragon fixed

Meteorite shower fixed

Elves and rogue hunters fixed

Samira (Elven Hunter) added a new sync and gave her more personality.

Storage system revised.

notes.title: known Steamversion bugs fixed
notes.notes:
Bugs associated with the Steam version have been fixed.

Aim hopping fixed
Mining (no items spawned) fixed
Trading system fixed
Save game system fixed

We hope we have been able to significantly improve the gaming experience and wish you continued enjoyment.
